React + Vite + Tailwind CSS ML portfolio for a BCA student. Authentic, modern developer/AI-dashboard design; `#38BDF8`, `#22D3EE`; Space Grotesk headings. Showcase ML projects, including Titanic Survival Prediction (Kaggle Titanic Dataset; Logistic Regression; Python, Pandas, Scikit-Learn). Use reusable, modular React components, icons, responsive grids, readable mobile text, large touch buttons, lazy-loaded images, and fade-in section reveals. Avoid exaggerated claims or fake expertise. Avoid heavy animations or distracting motion. Ensure mobile-first design. Avoid unnecessary dependencies. Avoid overly complex code. Content must remain authentic. Do NOT claim:
professional experience not actually achieved
research credentials not earned
If technically feasible, AI agents may implement a "Try the Model" Titanic survival prediction input form; skip if complex. UI should be clean, fast, and mobile-friendly.
